landing.heroSubtitle: Detect plant diseases instantly using deep learning computer vision and receive intelligent, actionable plant-care guidance powered by local Gemma 3.
landing.workflowSubtitle: Our 3-step hybrid architecture combines computer vision classification with local LLM reasoning.
landing.supportedCropsSubtitle: Disease detection for tomatoes, potatoes, apples, corn, grapes, peaches, peppers, strawberries and cherries.
landing.step1Desc: Snap or drag-and-drop a photo of any plant leaf showing unusual spots or discoloration.
landing.step2Desc: MobileNetV2 / EfficientNetB0 analyzes leaf micro-features to detect pathogens in seconds.
landing.step3Desc: Ollama Gemma 3 synthesizes symptoms, root causes, organic treatments, and prevention guidelines.
landing.aiResponseExample: “Fungal infection detected. Prune infected leaves immediately, increase canopy spacing, and apply organic copper fungicide.”
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to Protect Your Crops with AI?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Upload a leaf image right now or ask Gemma 3 any agricultural questions regarding pest management and crop health.
landing.architectureDesc1: Powered by MobileNetV2 / EfficientNetB0 neural networks trained on over 50,000 leaf samples from the PlantVillage dataset.
landing.architectureDesc2: Once the vision engine identifies the pathogen, local Gemma 3 generates comprehensive, practical care instructions.
landing.architectureFeature8: Zero Cloud Dependency (Runs Locally via Ollama)
